name: What are the current property tax rates for investment properties in Miami-Dade County?

mainEntity.name: What are the current property tax rates for investment properties in Miami-Dade County?

acceptedAnswer.text: Property tax rates in Miami-Dade County are calculated based on the assessed value of your property and the millage rates set by various taxing authorities (county, city, school board, etc.). These rates can fluctuate annually. For preparation, it's important to understand that investment properties typically do not qualify for homestead exemptions, which can significantly reduce taxes for owner-occupied homes. You should budget for the full tax amount based on the non-homestead assessment. Kelby Contreras can help you understand how these taxes impact your overall investment costs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Property tax rates in Miami-Dade County depend on assessed value and millage rates. Investment properties don't get homestead exemptions, so budget accordingly.
